description: Local simulated commissioning workflow with human approval before every procedure run

force_safe.note: Always available: moving to safe can never make things worse.

reset_trip.note: A human confirms the cause of the trip is understood.

request_permit.note: ProcessGuardrail decides; reset must precede permit.

run_procedure.note: Only approved procedures; the runtime may still refuse on preconditions.

ack_operator_step.note: Only a human can confirm a physical action was performed.

draft_procedure.note: Drafts are inert until an engineer approves them.

sandbox_experiment.note: Local isolated experiments only; no approval or physical authority
